note: Parks Canada campground in the East Block of Grasslands National Park, on open prairie above Rock Creek in badlands country, with a kitchen shelter, day-use area and 8 oTENTiks. Water at the tap is for small jugs only, so fill tanks before arriving. The Val Marie visitor centre and the West Block are about 2 hours away. --Claude
summary: Keep. Parks Canada pages: 24 tent/RV sites, all 50 A electric, 100% reservable; vault toilet, potable water for jugs (mid-May to Sep 30), dump, no showers; $36.75; open May 1 - Oct 12, 2026. Not waterfront kept; pin ~215 m W of the loop (optional nudge). Phone/website unchanged.
flags: WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. Rock Creek (a creek well under 30 m wide) winds ~90 m west of the westmost pads (Esri z16 at about 49.0709,-106.5300); nothing better than creek-nearby.
PIN: under 250 m - optional. Stored 49.0705,-106.5287 is at the reception/entrance at the loop's west end; the site loop centres on about 49.0710,-106.5258 (~215 m E).
SEASON: stored approximate 05-15..09-07 -> 05-01..10-12 (2026: reception open May 1 to October 12; 'All campgrounds close October 12, 2026'). Water only mid-May to September 30.
FACILITIES: showers false ('There are no showers in the campground'), vault toilet, potable water for jugs, RV dump tank.
PHONE: stored 306-298-2257 is the Grasslands park office line (not re-confirmed on today's pages, which give only 1-877-RESERVE and 1-888-773-8888); no change.
WEBSITE: stored frontcountry page answers 200; second line https://reservation.pc.gc.ca refuses bots (403, not retried) and duplicates the policy row - could be dropped, not dead.
POLICY ROW: consistent (100% reservable via Parks Canada; reservation fee 11.50; taxes included).
